provided.title: File:A section of Wakulima Market, Nairobi Kenya, May 2023.jpg

observed.caption: A covered market hall with vaulted concrete roofing, large piles of watermelons and produce, and several shoppers browsing stalls.
observed.description: The photo shows the interior of a large covered market with a dark weathered vaulted concrete roof supported by thick concrete pillars, with bright daylight entering through gaps in the roof and open sides. In the foreground and middle ground there are large piles of green striped watermelons, red mesh sacks resting on teal sacks, and trays and baskets containing brown bulbous produce in the immediate foreground. Several people are visible throughout the space, including a person in a teal shirt and blue patterned cap seated with back to the camera on the left, a person in a black t-shirt standing near the center, and a person in a striped shirt and white cap on the far left, with additional figures blurred in the background near red walls and market stalls holding colorful plastic bags and boxes on the right.
